description: Sourced AI buildout data: hyperscaler capex, data center projects, power deals, headline stats, the dated change log (events), what companies disclosed about backlog and customers (disclosures), and public regulatory filings tied to sites (filings). With ticker, also returns that company's project links grouped by grade, confirmed-only totals, deals, latest disclosure, filings and recent events. Use when the question is about capex, data centers, power deals, which companies are tied to a project, or what changed and when. Grades: confirmed means named by a party to the project in a filing or press release; reported means reported by credible press, not confirmed by a party; estimated means inferred from indirect evidence, and dropped if not re-checked within 180 days. Headline figures use confirmed links only. Announced capacity and investment are plans, not revenue, and many deals are non-binding. The log starts 2026-08-19; history before this feature shipped was reconstructed from weekly snapshots (backfilled: true). Filings are public records; the applicant may be a subsidiary, a filing is not an approval, and leadDays is descriptive.

section.description: stats: headline totals; capex: hyperscaler capex; projects: data center projects; power_deals: power purchase deals; events: the dated change log; disclosures: what companies disclosed about backlog, purchase commitments and customers; filings: public regulatory filings tied to sites.

since.description: events only: events on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

ticker.description: Only rows linked to this ticker. Also returns data.company: the company's project links grouped by grade, confirmed-only totals, power deals, latest disclosure, filings and recent events.
